seasonseries.title: St. Louis CITY SC vs. Minnesota United FC

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.

Goal! St. Louis City SC 0, Minnesota United FC 1. Tomás Chancalay (Minnesota United FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Joaquín Pereyra with a through ball following a fast break.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 1, Minnesota United FC 1. Daniel Edelman (St. Louis City SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 2, Minnesota United FC 1. Carlo Holse (St. Louis City SC) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Conrad Wallem.
Delay in match (St. Louis City SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! St. Louis City SC 3, Minnesota United FC 1. Rafael Navarro (St. Louis City SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Carlo Holse.
Second Half begins St. Louis City SC 3, Minnesota United FC 1.
